hook: Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.
caption:
Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.

Here's what no one talks about: ChatGPT doesn't know if you're a visual thinker who needs diagrams, or a systems thinker who needs the logic tree first, or someone who hates theory and just wants the next three steps.

So it guesses.

And the guess is... average. Statistically safe. Built for a person who is no one in particular.

That's why you keep rewriting your prompts. That's why you get answers that are technically correct but feel weirdly off. That's why you paste the response into a doc, sigh, and start editing it into something that actually sounds useful.

The problem isn't your prompts. The problem is that AI is meeting you for the first time. Every. Single. Time.

BootFile fixes that. It builds a persistent profile of how you actually think — your reasoning style, your communication preferences, what you need more of, what drives you insane — and loads it into every conversation before you type a single word.

No more teaching the robot who you are. It already knows.

Link in bio to build your profile. Takes 5 minutes.
